title: How to Loop a Slideshow
steps: Slide Show Tab > Set up slide show > Show options group > Loop continuously until 'ESC' > OK
Select all slides by clicking the first slide on the preview slide panel on the left and Shift + left click the last slide.
Uncheck the "On Mouse Click" on Slide Show Tab and check the "After" and adjust the timing on the slide advance

title: Video Imbedd Issues
steps: Ensure that the video still exists and is accessible through an empty browser (incognito mode)

If just the URL was provided, try switching it out for the embed tag (if it has one) on youtube: go to video  > share > embed > copy > go to PowerPoint, Insert Tab > Video > Online Video >  Add embed tag.
Select the video > Video Tools Tab> Playback Tab>Video Options group> Start Automatically or When Clicked

title: Changing the Display Settings (Windows)
steps: Press F8 (Fn Key + F8 ) to open the display menu
Select the display option you want to use (Duplicate, Extend, Second Screen Only, PC Screen Only)

title: Changing the Display Settings (Mac)
steps: Click on the apple Icon on the top left of the display > System Preferences  > Displays > Arrangement
Check the "Mirror Displays" box to duplicate the display or uncheck it to extend the display
